_comment_1: Copy this file to 'api_keys.json' (same folder) and fill in your values.
_comment_2: api_keys.json is gitignored; this example file is safe to commit.
_comment_llm: Local offline model. For LM Studio use llm_provider 'openai' (LM Studio speaks the OpenAI API). llm_url may include the /v1 suffix or not - both work. llm_model must match the model name shown in LM Studio's loaded-model list.
_comment_ollama: If you use Ollama instead of LM Studio, use these two lines instead of the three above: "llm_provider": "ollama", "llm_url": "http://localhost:11434", and set llm_model to your tag e.g. "hermes3".
_comment_optional: Everything below is optional - delete any line you do not want.
_comment_wake: Wake word + clap-to-wake. Off by default. See readme for training a real 'Hey Sam' model.
_comment_tts: Voice output. 'gemini' (default) uses Gemini Live's own voice. 'hybrid' uses ElevenLabs if a key is set, else offline Piper.
_comment_openai: Optional GPT-5 upgrade for complex tasks. Leave both blank/default to use Gemini (recommended - no extra cost).
_comment_dashboard: Phone-pairing dashboard. HTTPS cert is generated locally on first run, never shipped in the package.
_comment_phone: Optional automated phone calls for overnight project updates. Supports Twilio Voice or Windows Phone Link.
